exact_statement: Let F(x,y)=sum_{t in F2^2} chi_{J0+t1 A+t2 B}(x) 1_{C_t}(y)(-1)^{q_t(y)}, where the at most four nonempty C_t are disjoint affine cells partitioning an independent uniform physical Y cube, each q_t is quadratic in affine coordinates, and J0,A,B are arbitrary X-frequency vectors. Every physical restriction of F satisfies H(S_Y|S_X)<=H(F)<=24 I_Y(F). At current label rank2 the full rate is4, at rank1 it is24, and at rank0 it is16 h2(1/16)<11/2. All fresh Boolean tensor factors have F2 phase degree<=5; the five-bit monomial phase is admitted and the six-bit monomial phase is excluded. The constants are independent of X-degree bound d>=1 and dimension; no spectral independence is assumed.
hypotheses: Independent uniform physical X,Y cubes and Boolean signs
Four affine cell partition with quadratic phases; empty cells allowed
X-frequency labels in one affine plane, allowing rank0 or1 degeneracy
Entropy bits, original physical influence; optional occupied X labels have degree<=any integer d>=1

first_unproved_line: At frequency rank3 an intermediate rank1 projection can have a proper nonaffine FOUR-cell row that cannot be coarsened to two affine quadratic pieces. Complete-cover phase interpolation does not apply there. No universal erasure/history/reference payment is proved.
